evidence.title: Trump gasses up US-Venezuela oil revenue, but ‘hundreds of billions’ is too high

occurrences.checkable_against: White House executive order on safeguarding Venezuelan oil revenue issued January 2026
occurrences.quote_span: An executive order issued days after Maduro’s ouster said oil revenue would be the Venezuelan government property but held in U.S. government accounts in a “custodial and governmental capacity.”
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Trump administration statements and Venezuelan oil production and investment records
occurrences.quote_span: The Trump administration said it would control Venezuela’s oil industry, which has a lot of reserves but has struggled over the last decade to secure the capital investment needed to bring that oil to market.
occurrences.speaker: Trump administration
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Trump’s August 4 statement and oil revenue estimates
occurrences.quote_span: That is roughly a tenth of the “hundreds of billions of dollars” in gains that President Donald Trump cited for each country.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Financial Times analysis and Venezuelan oil shipment and price data
occurrences.quote_span: The highest credible figure for oil revenue since the U.S. took over Venezuela’s oil industry in January is $13 billion.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Justice Department case records and White House or State Department records on Maduro’s arrest and transfer
occurrences.quote_span: President Donald Trump says oil revenues are flowing to the U.S. and Venezuela since the U.S. arrested then-leader Nicolás Maduro in January and brought him to New York City for trial on drug and corruption charges.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Published oil revenue estimates and PolitiFact interview records with named analysts
occurrences.quote_span: Analysts told PolitiFact they were unaware of oil revenue estimates that reached into the hundreds of billions for either country.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: PolitiFact email interview with Phil Gunson dated August 5, 2026 and U.S. and Venezuelan disbursement records
occurrences.quote_span: Gunson said it’s unclear “where all that money went, how much was sent to Venezuela and what it was spent on.”
occurrences.speaker: Phil Gunson
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. State Department report or testimony to Congress in April 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The State Department told Congress in April it had spent $3 billion for operating costs, such as oil industry supplies and government worker salaries.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. State Department
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: International Monetary Fund Venezuela GDP data accessed August 5, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Venezuela’s GDP is about $111 billion , according to the International Monetary Fund.
occurrences.speaker: International Monetary Fund
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News interview transcript of August 4, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: During an Aug. 4 Fox News interview , Trump said voters in the midterm elections “want to see winning,” and he offered Venezuela as an example.
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. and Venezuelan government oil revenue reports and disbursement records
occurrences.quote_span: Neither government has produced a single, easy-to-locate and up-to-date dollar amount of how much oil revenue has been generated, nor who has received the money.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: PolitiFact email interview with Dany Bahar dated August 5, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: “ Even with the most generous assumption you’d never get there,” said Dany Bahar, a Brown University visiting fellow in international and public affairs.
occurrences.speaker: Dany Bahar
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Financial Times analysis published July 22, 2026 and IMF Venezuela GDP data
occurrences.quote_span: The Financial Times estimated that oil revenues account for about a quarter of Venezuela’s GDP.
occurrences.speaker: Financial Times
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Financial Times analysis published July 22, 2026 and Venezuelan crude shipment and pricing data
occurrences.quote_span: A July 22 Financial Times analysis estimated that the U.S. has collected about $13 billion in Venezuelan oil revenue.
occurrences.speaker: Financial Times
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: PolitiFact email interview with David Smilde dated August 5, 2026, Venezuelan budget records, and oil revenue disbursement records
occurrences.quote_span: “My sense is that there has been quite a bit of revenue returning to Venezuela, but given the government’s budget deficit and all of the need, it does not have the impact people expect,” Smilde said.
occurrences.speaker: David Smilde
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: PolitiFact email interview with Phil Gunson dated August 5, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: “The hundreds of billions figure is not remotely credible,” said Phil Gunson, a senior analyst with the International Crisis Group, a nonprofit that studies deadly conflicts.
occurrences.speaker: Phil Gunson
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Venezuelan national budget publications and PolitiFact email interview with Phil Gunson dated August 5, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: He said transparency was not a priority in Venezuela even before Maduro’s ouster; the country has not published a national budget in more than a decade.
occurrences.speaker: Phil Gunson
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of Trump’s July 2026 Air Force One remarks
occurrences.quote_span: Trump was skeptical of the $13 billion figure for oil revenue when a reporter referenced the estimate on Air Force One in July, saying “I think (it’s) even more than that.”
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Energy Department fact sheet on Venezuela oil revenue dated January 7, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The U.S. Energy Department said the funds would be “disbursed for the benefit of the American people and the Venezuelan people.”
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Energy Department
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: PolitiFact email interview with David Smilde dated August 5, 2026 and Financial Times analysis
occurrences.quote_span: David Smilde, a senior associate at Tulane University’s Center for Inter-American Policy Research, described Trump’s Aug. 4 figure as “not possible” and said the most recent credible amount he’s seen is the Financial Times’ $13 billion.
occurrences.speaker: David Smilde
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: International Monetary Fund Venezuela GDP data and Trump’s oil revenue estimate
occurrences.quote_span: Trump’s estimate exceeds the entire gross domestic product of Venezuela several times over.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: International Monetary Fund Venezuela GDP data accessed August 5, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Venezuela’s GDP is about $111 billion , according to the International Monetary Fund.
occurrences.speaker: International Monetary Fund
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. State Department recognition records and Venezuelan government records
occurrences.quote_span: After Maduro’s arrest, Delcy Rodríguez , vice president at the time, took over as interim president; the U.S. recognized her as head of state in March.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Embassy in Caracas assistance update and U.S. government foreign assistance records
occurrences.quote_span: The U.S. has also sent Venezuela $386 million for disaster relief after two major earthquakes on June 24.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Venezuelan government Transparencia Soberana revenue tracker
occurrences.quote_span: A Venezuelan government site that tracks revenue for U.S.-sold oil shows $300 million in revenue sent to Venezuela through March.
occurrences.speaker: Government of Venezuela
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News interview transcript of August 4, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Donald Trump stated on August 4, 2026 in a Fox News interview: In Venezuela, “We’re making hundreds of billions of dollars (in oil revenue), and so are they.”
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Financial Times Venezuelan oil revenue analysis and U.S. and Venezuelan government disbursement records
occurrences.quote_span: The best estimates show $13 billion in Venezuelan oil revenue since Maduro’s ouster, and it’s unclear how much of that went to the United States and how much to Venezuela.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Venezuelan national budget publications and official gazette records
occurrences.quote_span: the country has not published a national budget in more than a decade.
occurrences.speaker: Phil Gunson
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue

occurrences.checkable_against: Kpler Venezuelan crude shipment data, Argus Media Venezuelan crude price estimates, and Financial Times analysis
occurrences.quote_span: The Financial Times looked at data on crude oil shipments from Venezuela since January compiled by the freight data platform Kpler, combined with price estimates for several grades of Venezuelan crude oil supplied by Argus Media, a pricing agency.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump’s claim about US-Venezuela oil revenue
